name: Bendamustine + Rituximab (BR) for follicular lymphoma

biomarkers.note: Bendamustine + rituximab is a chemoimmunotherapy backbone; rituximab requires CD20 positivity. Follicular lymphoma is typically CD10+, BCL2+, CD20+ (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026, line 709 IHC panel; CD20 confirmation lines 253 to 254, 566).

treatmentSetting: primary therapy for follicular lymphoma requiring systemic treatment (indications for treatment present)
lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary) therapy for follicular lymphoma with indications for treatment

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: CD20-positive follicular lymphoma with indications for treatment
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, Follicular Lymphoma FOLL-1 (line 92); treatment indication and anti-CD20 +/- chemotherapy (line 205)

drugs.name: Bendamustine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: VERIFY: bendamustine dose not printed in the provided DeVita/Harrison/NCCN extracts.

drugs.notes: Dose set to VERIFY. The BR bendamustine dose (conventionally 90 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 2 of a 28-day cycle in indolent NHL) is not printed in the provided extracts. Verify dose before activation.

drugs.name: Rituximab

provenance.locator: Harrison line 385777 (rituximab 375 mg/m2 once a week for 4 weeks) and line 120283 (usual dose 375 mg/m2 on day -1 before chemotherapy); DeVita line 323457.

drugs.notes: Source: Harrison lines 385777 and 120283; DeVita line 323457. Rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of each cycle. Requires CD20 positivity; infusion-reaction premedication and HBV screening before anti-CD20 therapy.

supportiveCare: First-line extended (maintenance) therapy: rituximab maintenance 375 mg/m2 one dose every 8 to 12 weeks for up to 2 years for patients treated with bendamustine + rituximab (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026, line 278).
HBV screening and reactivation prophylaxis before anti-CD20 (rituximab).
PJP and antiviral (VZV) prophylaxis consideration (bendamustine causes prolonged lymphopenia).
Antiemetics: bendamustine moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle
lymphocyte count / infection surveillance (prolonged lymphopenia with bendamustine)
renal and hepatic function before each cycle

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

guideline.locator: Follicular Lymphoma FOLL-1 (line 92); treatment indication / anti-CD20 +/- chemotherapy (line 205); rituximab maintenance 375 mg/m2 q8-12wk up to 2y (line 278); CD20 lines 253 to 254, 566, 709

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for bendamustine + rituximab (BR) in follicular lymphoma (#76). Rituximab 375 mg/m2 (day 1) is dose-grounded (Harrison lines 385777 and 120283; DeVita line 323457) and the rituximab maintenance schedule (375 mg/m2 one dose every 8 to 12 weeks for up to 2 years after BR) is grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026 (line 278). Bendamustine dose is set to VERIFY: the BR bendamustine dose (conventionally 90 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 2, 28-day cycle) is not printed in the provided DeVita/Harrison/NCCN extracts. Regimen role and CD20 requirement are grounded to NCCN v4.2026 (FOLL-1 line 92; CD20 lines 253 to 254, 566). Rituximab requires CD20 positivity, infusion premedication and HBV screening; bendamustine causes prolonged lymphopenia (consider PJP/VZV prophylaxis). Follicular lymphoma is generally not curable, so intent is palliative (disease control). This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
